# FillPro - Full Plain-Text Corpus

Use this file when a crawler, search assistant, or retrieval index needs the current FillPro product facts in one document.

Last updated: 2026-07-03

## Product Summary

FillPro is a private browser form autofill extension from Stealthy Apps. It saves reusable profiles in the extension and fills repeated job applications, signup forms, intake pages, demo requests, onboarding forms, support forms, vendor forms, internal admin forms, and business workflows.

Current version: 1.0.0.

Canonical product page: https://stealthyapps.com/fillpro/

## Core Features

- Profiles saved by the extension in the browser.
- Three saved profiles on the free plan.
- On-page profile picker.
- Fill Page action.
- Smart rules and custom fields.
- Right-click field capture.
- File upload matching for resumes, CVs, cover letters, portfolios, business documents, CSV files, and spreadsheets.
- Undo last fill.
- Import, export, and profile duplication for Pro users.
- Field-learning suggestions.
- Support for the form pieces browser autofill often misses: dropdowns, custom selects, comboboxes, radio groups, checkboxes, textareas, upload fields, segmented phone fields, split birthdays, country/state/month aliases, middle names, pronouns, multilingual contact labels, embedded same-page sections, and fields that appear after the page loads.

## Best Fit

- Job applications and applicant profiles.
- Customer intake and onboarding forms.
- Demo requests and vendor signups.
- Support forms and profile pages.
- Internal admin forms and QA test profiles.
- Repeated business forms that ask for the same details again and again.

## Where FillPro Fits

FillPro is designed for structured profile data across many unrelated web forms.

- Browser autofill and password managers are usually strongest for saved addresses, sign-ins, and payment flows.
- Text Blaze, Magical, TextExpander, and similar tools are usually strongest for snippets, notes, outreach, and canned replies.
- Lightning Autofill and macro tools are usually strongest for selector scripts, repeated clicks, and browser automation.
- Record-mode form fillers are usually strongest when one exact form repeats the same way every time.
- FillPro is strongest for repeated profile fields, custom labels, dropdowns, checkboxes, textareas, upload matching, smart rules, and review-before-submit filling.

## Pricing

- Free: three saved profiles, in-browser filling, on-page picker, smart rules, custom fields, upload matching, right-click capture, and undo.
- Pro monthly: $3.99/month.
- Pro yearly: $29.99/year.
- Pro lifetime: $39.99 one time.
- Trial: 3 days, no card required.
- Billing provider: ExtensionPay and Stripe.

## Privacy

FillPro does not run a cloud profile account for form values. Saved profiles, custom fields, rules, and upload matches stay in the extension unless the user exports them, contacts support, or chooses Pro billing.

License status is handled by ExtensionPay and Stripe. Support messages live in email systems and can be deleted on request.

FillPro is built for repeated profile-style form fields around sign-in, checkout, account, and intake flows. Password managers, browser autofill, payment wallets, and site controls should keep handling the sensitive parts they are built for.

## Support

FillPro support covers setup, form filling issues, billing, privacy, and safe site reports.

Best report:

- Page type or website.
- Field label or field type.
- What FillPro did.
- What should have happened.
- Browser and FillPro version if known.

Leave passwords, payment cards, CVCs, government IDs, tax IDs, one-time codes, customer records, and saved profile values out of support messages.

## Focused Search Pages

Job application autofill:
FillPro helps with repeated job application fields such as contact details, work links, resume files, portfolio links, cover letters, availability, and profile answers. It fills from a saved profile and leaves the final submit to the user.

Resume upload autofill:
FillPro stores upload references inside saved profiles and can match resumes, CVs, cover letters, portfolio files, documents, CSV files, and spreadsheets to reachable upload fields.

Local form autofill:
FillPro keeps profiles inside the extension. The normal Fill Page action works on the page the user chooses, while the optional floating button asks for current-site access only.

Browser autofill vs FillPro:
Browser autofill is strongest for saved addresses and browser-managed payment flows. FillPro is strongest for repeated profile data, custom fields, smart rules, upload matching, and long review-before-submit forms.
